direction_classification.method: Ambient edge direction projected onto the mapped authority principal directions for splits assigned to a selected original face by exact split-only lineage.

rejections.note: Rejected-trial callbacks, geometry-guidance counters and logical split trials are distinct; no logical-trial refusal fraction inferred.

patch_decision.reason: Split-only replay proves descendants only when edit counters, input/output physical faces, published split records and fixed observations agree exactly. Otherwise the affected criterion remains unresolved.
patch_decision.reject_requires: A certified lower bound above tolerance after two geometric curved-direction halvings; topological depth alone is insufficient and does not trigger rejection here.
patch_decision.support_requires: Complete fixed-face descendant coverage, two halvings, every required upper bound at or below tolerance, and all other plan gates.

plan_gates.logical_refusal_fraction: unresolved; exact logical trial denominator unavailable
